sections.label: Home ownership and housing affordability
sections.summary: The government remains committed to helping Singaporeans own homes and keeping housing affordable, with the market on track for a soft landing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We remain committed to help Singaporeans own their homes and keep housing affordable for future generations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We have addressed the demand-supply imbalance in the housing market, which is on track for a soft landing.

sections.label: Fresh Start Housing Scheme
sections.summary: The Fresh Start Housing Scheme will help second-timer public rental families committed to improving their situation own a home again.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Fresh Start Housing Scheme will help second-timer public rental families, who are committed to improving their situation, own a home again.

sections.label: Seniors ageing in place
sections.summary: The enhanced Lease Buyback Scheme enables more seniors to age-in-place and unlock some value from their flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We will help our seniors to age gracefully and with peace of mind in their retirement years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We have enhanced the Lease Buyback Scheme to enable more seniors to age-in-place and unlock some value from their flats.

sections.label: Accessible greenery near homes
sections.summary: 90% of households will live within 400 metres of a park or park connector by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Singaporeans can enjoy more lush greenery near their homes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We will make greenery more accessible to Singaporeans, with 90% of households living within 400 metres of a park or park connector by 2030.

sections.label: Walking, cycling, greenery and food supply
sections.summary: Ang Mo Kio and Tampines will be piloted as model walking and cycling towns, buildings greened, and local food supply improved.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Ang Mo Kio and Tampines will be piloted as model walking and cycling towns while new areas, such as Marina South and Kampong Bugis, will feature more walkable ground spaces with social and retail amenities and reduced road space and car usage.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We have made good progress in greening our new and existing buildings to be more energy-efficient.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In addition to diversifying our overseas food supply, we will look for new avenues to improve our local food supply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We must continue to develop technologies and innovate to increase productivity of our local farms.
